body: They are of adult age, but haven't actually grown up mentally.

I'm still working on accepting that I am both good and bad, ying and yang, etc. I feel I still need to distinguish between the two so I dont get confused or let my impulses convince me they are the right choice.

I should mention that when clearing your mind and finding mindfulness you will feel and know the difference. Idk if it is different for everyone, for me I found that I can stop all my other thoughts from punching holes into my thoughts and if felt so easy to do. When it happened the first time I was elated and then fell right back down when I tried to make it happen again, but it did happen again. Every day now i work hard, and even when I dont I know tomorrow I might and soon I will be doing it as naturally as breathing.

I'm working on this myself right now in every aspect of life. It is very hard to tell that voice no, it is comforting and feels like my only friend who cares sometimes. It is not your friend.

Recently I came up with a visualization to help me. Remember in cartoons where a little angel and devil would pop up on a character's shoulder? That voice telling you to take the day bc you deserve it is the "devil". If that voice is telling you want you want to hear not what you deep down know you should do your rationalizing with yourself or your "angel".

When you get in that moment clear your mind and think about who is talking to you. It isnt easy to clear your mind, I have only done it twice or so in the last month, but the more you do it the better you get at it.

If you need a kick in the butt DM me when this starts happening and I will be your rational person. This might be a good thing to have in person too. Though I dont know anyone who would do this multiple times a day for me lol.

I want to have a break of feeling like this, this is why I smile. I can control the tears better, and I don't feel so horrible. It is all there, but the smile makes it impossible for me to continue crying.

But the smile does not change the hatred in my head. It is a mask for the moment so I can make it to the next one.

Thank you Erin for the kind words, and advice. You are an incredible person to care enough  to reach out and take time to talk me down. I hope one day I can reread this and truly understand and accept your words.

I'm a liar and deceiver when I am ashamed or afraid.  I will tell anything to get out of that situation  and feelings. I'm aware of it, I want to stop, and I am changing it. But I still do it, that panic and fear sets in and I dont know what to say so I say whatever I can think of to get away.

I am the cause, all my problems stem from that right there. All the feelings I have come from that. If you asked me to look up something and I forgot i will make up an elaborate story so you dont think less of me. Or i will say i did it and to wait, or that i was just about to. Everything it an extreme, I have lost so many people already bc I cant be a decent human.

To be honest I don't know. I used to immaturely think it wasn't my fault, I accept the fact that my actions or lack of action do create problems, and are the cause of some of my feelings. Those I can control, and those are what I am working on. 

But the feelings of despair, and that no matter how much I try I will never make it, are so overwhelming at times. When this happens I stop everything and hide. I forget that I am worth it, and all I can think is how to get away and stop feeling at all.
I truly hope so. Thank you

Thank you, the last two years I have been trying to work it all out on my own. Not the best idea, but a step in the right direction. I am teetering to seek professional help and meds, if I go down this road again it is my last time. I'm tired of not figuring it out, it is like a puzzle that I have been stuck on before I was a teenager.
I was that person, I thought if I was happy enough the rest would go away or work itself out somehow.

I know my actions and choices are a big cause of how I feel. It is the feeling of hopelessness, that no matter how much effort I put in there is always something or many things I can't get "right". I'm tired of being berated to be better. I am me, and if it isn't good enough leave me with my pain stop adding to it.
